In December, Mr. Trump announced that Nvidia could sell its more powerful H200 chips to China in exchange for 25 percent of revenue flowing to the U.S. government. Mr. Trump has told aides he regards Nvidia as central to the stock market and the broader economy.

12月，特朗普宣布英伟达可向中国出售其更强大的H200芯片，条件是将销售收入的25%交给美国政府。特朗普曾告诉助手，他认为英伟达对美国股市乃至整体经济都至关重要。

财长贝森特一直主张采取更严格的措施限制中国获取先进人工智能芯片。

The data center rule had stalled within the administration for months. Mr. Trump approved it in August, according to two senior officials, but the Commerce Department did not issue it. The Biden administration had imposed similar restrictions just before leaving office. The Trump administration rescinded them last year, and several drafts of replacement rules have died since.

有关数据中心的新规此前已在特朗普政府内部搁置数月。据两名高级官员透露，特朗普早在8月就批准了这项规定，但商务部一直没有发布。拜登政府在卸任前夕曾实施类似限制，特朗普政府去年将其撤销，此后拟定的多个替代方案也都不了了之。

Current and former officials who support a tougher stance against Beijing said they hoped that Mr. Trump’s words on Monday were merely diplomatic niceties, and that he would follow through on the chip restrictions and let the Megaspeed investigation run its course.

支持对北京采取更强硬立场的现任和前任官员表示，他们希望特朗普周一的言论只是外交辞令，并希望他能落实芯片限制措施，让Megaspeed调查按程序进行下去。

Others who have worked for the president were more skeptical. Since Mr. Trump retreated from his tariff war with Beijing in May 2025, he has made clear to his national security team that he is wary of taking any actions that might disrupt the trading relationship.

其他曾为总统工作的人则更为怀疑。自2025年5月特朗普在与北京的关税战中作出退让以来，他已向国家安全团队明确表示，自己不愿采取任何可能扰乱美中贸易关系的行动。

H.R. McMaster, who served as Mr. Trump’s national security adviser in 2017 and 2018 and has been critical of the president since leaving the administration, said Mr. Trump’s instinct for deal-making had repeatedly undercut his China policy.

曾于2017年至2018年担任特朗普国家安全顾问的H·R·麦克马斯特，在离开政府后一直批评特朗普。他表示，特朗普热衷于达成交易的本能屡屡削弱其对华政策。

“I think President Trump is often impeded by his belief that he can get the deal nobody else can get,” Mr. McMaster said. “And as a result, instead of having a consistent policy of competing against China’s policy of economic aggression, he often vacillates and weakens his own position.”

“我认为，特朗普总统常常受制于这样一种信念——他能够达成别人都无法达成的协议，”麦克马斯特说。“结果，他非但没有采取一以贯之的政策来应对中国咄咄逼人的经济政策，反而经常摇摆不定，削弱了自己的立场。”

Jonathan Swan是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。

Maggie Haberman是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。

Ana Swanson报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。

Shawn McCreesh是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统及其政府。

blocks.text: JONATHAN SWAN, MAGGIE HABERMAN, ANA SWANSON, SHAWN McCREESH2026年11月18日

President Trump headed on Monday for a trip to Asia to meet President Xi Jinping of China with his administration openly divided over how hard to squeeze that country on artificial intelligence technology.
特朗普总统周一启程前往亚洲，准备与中国国家主席习近平举行会晤。与此同时，特朗普政府内部对于如何在人工智能技术领域向中国施压存在公开分歧。
Mr. Trump noted before he left that he has not wanted to make moves that “insult China.”
特朗普在出发前表示，他不想采取“冒犯中国”的举动。

The public airing of the fight over China policy inside Mr. Trump’s cabinet shows how much the fallout of the Nvidia scandal has deepened fissures inside the government, forcing into view a debate about how the United States should reckon with Beijing.
特朗普内阁内部对华政策之争公开化表明，英伟达丑闻的余波进一步加深了政府内部的裂痕，也使美国应该如何应对北京的争论浮出水面。

Mr. Trump, who is due to meet Mr. Xi and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia at a summit in the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen this week, has struggled to balance national security concerns about America’s most powerful rival against his desire to prop up Nvidia’s chips business and avoid another trade war with Mr. Xi.
特朗普定于本周在中国科技中心深圳举行的峰会上与习近平和俄罗斯总统普京会晤。他既要应对美国头号竞争对手带来的国家安全挑战，又希望扶持英伟达的芯片业务，并避免与中国再次爆发贸易战，在这些目标之间，他一直难以取得平衡。

Those tensions were center stage on Monday as the president acknowledged that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick had been at odds over how hard to crack down on a loophole that has allowed China to access advanced A.I. chips through data centers in other countries.
周一，这些矛盾成为关注焦点。特朗普承认，财政部长贝森特与商务部长卢特尼克一直存在分歧，争论的焦点是应该采取多严厉的措施，堵住中国通过其他国家的数据中心获取先进人工智能芯片的漏洞。

上周，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在两段婚外情曝光后辞职，使这场争论进一步激化。其中一段婚外情的对象是黄乐(Alice Huang)，美国官员认定她是中国情报机构的一名线人。
马来西亚一处正在建设中的数据中心园区，摄于上个月。

在这场风波中，特朗普在公开场合似乎更担心冒犯习近平，而不是国家安全面临的风险。他一直试图淡化有关美国情报官员以及国务卿鲁比奥曾亲自就黄仁勋的婚外情及中国间谍活动向他发出警告的报道。

中国官员否认黄乐是情报人员。周一，特朗普再次对她的间谍身份表示怀疑。
“I don’t know that she is a spy,” he told reporters. “Usually, what happens with that is that any woman coming to the country that’s a beautiful woman that comes from China, they say she’s a spy.”
“我不知道她是不是间谍，”他对记者说。“一般说来，只要有漂亮的中国女人来到这个国家，他们就会说她是间谍。”
A reporter noted that Mr. Rubio had warned him about Ms. Huang being spy. “Who told me that?” the president asked.

Told that it was Mr. Rubio, he said: “I haven’t heard that.”
在记者告诉他是鲁比奥后，他说：“我没听说过。”

On the other side are Mr. Bessent; Mr. Rubio, who is also Mr. Trump’s national security adviser; the U.S. trade representative, Jamieson Greer; and much of the National Security Council staff. 据六名以上直接了解相关讨论的现任和前任官员称，特朗普政府内部在对华政策上的分歧并不限于这两位争执不下的内阁部长。争论一方是卢特尼克，他的部门负责制定和执行芯片出口规定，他推动对数据中心采取更宽松的限制措施。另一方是贝森特、特朗普的国家安全顾问鲁比奥、美国贸易代表格里尔，以及国家安全委员会的大部分人。几个月来，他们一直主张全面限制中国获取人工智能芯片。
The president has drifted between the two camps in private, depending on the day, according to advisers.
据顾问们透露，特朗普私下里在两派之间摇摆不定，立场时常变化。

In a Friday television interview, Mr. Bessent faulted the Commerce Department for failing to sanction Megaspeed, the Singaporean company at the center of the Nvidia scandal, saying that the department “has the pen.” He also said that Nvidia should be “held accountable” if it did not do enough to stop the illegal diversion of chips to China.

Then in May, aboard Air Force One, Mr. Rubio briefed Mr. Trump on the intelligence in person, the officials said.

在整场风波中，特朗普始终支持黄仁勋。据《纽约时报》上周报道，总统曾致电黄仁勋，敦促他努力保住职位。周一，特朗普表示，他“不介意”看到黄仁勋复职。“我认为他吸取了一个很大的教训，”特朗普说。

Mr. Huang has cultivated the president since the start of the second term, praising him lavishly in public and making announcements of huge investments that Mr. Trump has touted as administration successes.
自第二任期开始以来，黄仁勋一直着力与总统建立关系，不仅在公开场合对他大加赞扬，还宣布了多项巨额投资计划，而特朗普将这些投资吹捧为政府政绩。

In August 2025, Mr. Trump allowed Nvidia to resume exports of its H20 chips to China on condition of a 15 percent cut for the government — though Beijing never approved the sales. Two months later, Nvidia committed $25 million to Mr. Trump’s White House ballroom.
2025年8月，特朗普允许英伟达恢复向中国出口H20芯片，条件是将销售收入的15%上缴美国政府，但北京方面始终没有批准相关销售。两个月后，英伟达承诺为特朗普的白宫宴会厅项目捐款2500万美元。

In December, Mr. Trump announced that Nvidia could sell its more powerful H200 chips to China in exchange for 25 percent of revenue flowing to the U.S. government. Mr. Trump has told aides he regards Nvidia as central to the stock market and the broader economy.
12月，特朗普宣布英伟达可向中国出售其更强大的H200芯片，条件是将销售收入的25%交给美国政府。特朗普曾告诉助手，他认为英伟达对美国股市乃至整体经济都至关重要。
财长贝森特一直主张采取更严格的措施限制中国获取先进人工智能芯片。

The data center rule had stalled within the administration for months. Mr. Trump approved it in August, according to two senior officials, but the Commerce Department did not issue it. The Biden administration had imposed similar restrictions just before leaving office. The Trump administration rescinded them last year, and several drafts of replacement rules have died since.
有关数据中心的新规此前已在特朗普政府内部搁置数月。据两名高级官员透露，特朗普早在8月就批准了这项规定，但商务部一直没有发布。拜登政府在卸任前夕曾实施类似限制，特朗普政府去年将其撤销，此后拟定的多个替代方案也都不了了之。

Current and former officials who support a tougher stance against Beijing said they hoped that Mr. Trump’s words on Monday were merely diplomatic niceties, and that he would follow through on the chip restrictions and let the Megaspeed investigation run its course.
支持对北京采取更强硬立场的现任和前任官员表示，他们希望特朗普周一的言论只是外交辞令，并希望他能落实芯片限制措施，让Megaspeed调查按程序进行下去。

Others who have worked for the president were more skeptical. Since Mr. Trump retreated from his tariff war with Beijing in May 2025, he has made clear to his national security team that he is wary of taking any actions that might disrupt the trading relationship.
其他曾为总统工作的人则更为怀疑。自2025年5月特朗普在与北京的关税战中作出退让以来，他已向国家安全团队明确表示，自己不愿采取任何可能扰乱美中贸易关系的行动。

H.R. McMaster, who served as Mr. Trump’s national security adviser in 2017 and 2018 and has been critical of the president since leaving the administration, said Mr. Trump’s instinct for deal-making had repeatedly undercut his China policy.
曾于2017年至2018年担任特朗普国家安全顾问的H·R·麦克马斯特，在离开政府后一直批评特朗普。他表示，特朗普热衷于达成交易的本能屡屡削弱其对华政策。

“I think President Trump is often impeded by his belief that he can get the deal nobody else can get,” Mr. McMaster said. “And as a result, instead of having a consistent policy of competing against China’s policy of economic aggression, he often vacillates and weakens his own position.”
“我认为，特朗普总统常常受制于这样一种信念——他能够达成别人都无法达成的协议，”麦克马斯特说。“结果，他非但没有采取一以贯之的政策来应对中国咄咄逼人的经济政策，反而经常摇摆不定，削弱了自己的立场。”
Jonathan Swan是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。
Maggie Haberman是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。
Ana Swanson报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。
Shawn McCreesh是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统及其政府。

items.body:
蒙古国总统呼日勒苏赫当地时间17日上午宣布辞职。按照蒙古国相关法律规定，总统辞职决定须经国家大呼拉尔（议会）批准方能生效。
执政党蒙古人民党内部人士、乌兰巴托前市长尼亚姆巴特尔周六公开揭发呼日勒苏赫在2019年担任总理期间，未经公开竞争性招标，将大型铁路项目交给特定企业，并涉嫌收受2500万美元贿赂。
事件曝光后，反对党要求总统下台，另有两名涉案高官宣布辞职。呼日勒苏赫否认“偷窃过人民或国家的财产”，表示愿意接受调查。

items.summary: 黄仁勋女儿留任引发担忧：脾气暴躁，曾导致多名高管离职 Telegraph | 原文链接 | 频道大全
items.body:
KALLEY HUANG, TRIPP MICKLE, RYAN MAC2026年11月17日

8月，英伟达产品营销高级总监、黄仁勋之女黄敏珊在北京的2026年世界机器人大会上。 Maxim Shemetov/Reuters

Madison Huang was yelling. Her father, Nvidia’s chief executive, Jensen Huang, had been scheduled to headline a conference in New Delhi in February. Shortly before the event, Mr. Huang pulled out and tapped a longtime lieutenant, Jay Puri, to attend in his place.

黄敏珊在大吼。她的父亲、英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋原定于今年2月在新德里一场会议上发表主题演讲。活动前不久，黄仁勋退出，并指定长期副手杰伊·普里代为出席。

But Nvidia hadn’t buttoned up its plans for the conference, infuriating Ms. Huang. On a call ahead of the event, Ms. Huang berated other employees — including Mr. Puri — for being unprepared, said three people familiar with the meeting. Eventually, Mr. Puri interrupted and told Ms. Huang he could answer her questions if she stopped yelling at him.

但英伟达没有敲定会议计划，这令黄敏珊勃然大怒。据三名熟悉会议情况的人士说，在活动前的一次电话会议上，黄敏珊斥责普里等其他员工准备不足。最终，普里打断她，告诉黄敏珊，如果她停止对他大喊大叫，他就可以回答她的问题。

Less than six months later, Mr. Puri left his role at Nvidia.

不到六个月后，普里离开了英伟达的职位。

The tense meeting highlighted the powerful and sometimes disruptive role Ms. Huang, 35, played at the company her father co-founded, according to more than a dozen current and former employees who spoke on condition of anonymity about the family’s leadership of Nvidia. Before Mr. Huang resigned last week, she had become his de facto chief of staff, with considerable authority over more seasoned executives.

据十多名现任和前任员工说，这场气氛紧张的会议凸显了35岁的黄敏珊在她父亲共同创立的公司中扮演的有力且有时具有破坏性的角色。他们要求匿名谈论黄氏家族对英伟达的领导。在上周黄仁勋辞职前，她已成为父亲事实上的幕僚长，对更有经验的高管拥有相当大的权力。

That influence creates an immediate challenge for Colette Kress, Nvidia’s interim chief executive, who replaced Mr. Huang after his resignation last week. Ms. Kress must quickly determine how much power Ms. Huang will have in the company after her father’s exit. She must also decide what to do about Mr. Huang’s other family members employed at the company: his son, Spencer Huang, and his son-in-law, Nico Caprez.

这种影响力给英伟达临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯带来了直接挑战。克雷斯在上周黄仁勋辞职后接替他。克雷斯必须迅速确定，黄敏珊在她父亲退出后将在公司拥有多大权力。她还必须决定，如何处置黄仁勋在公司雇用的其他家庭成员：他的儿子黄胜斌和女婿尼科·卡普雷斯。

Mr. Huang resigned after revelations that he had had extramarital relationships with an Nvidia executive and a customer that U.S. intelligence concluded was working for Chinese intelligence.

黄仁勋辞职是因为有报道披露他曾与一名英伟达高管以及一名客户发生婚外情，而美国情报部门认定这名客户为中国情报机构工作。

The continued presence of Ms. Huang has raised concerns among senior executives that she has conflicted loyalties between the company and her father. Those concerns were heightened over the last few days as Mr. Huang’s allies in Silicon Valley and on Wall Street started a campaign to reinstate him, and President Trump said he “would not mind” if Mr. Huang returned to his job.

黄敏珊的继续留任引发了高级管理人员的担忧，认为她在公司和她父亲之间存在忠诚冲突。过去几天，随着黄仁勋在硅谷和华尔街的盟友发起让他复职的运动，以及特朗普总统表示自己“不会介意”黄仁勋重返职位，这些担忧加剧了。

The Huang family, including Jensen, Madison and Spencer, and Mr. Puri did not respond to requests for comment.

黄家（包括黄仁勋、黄敏珊和黄胜斌）以及普里没有回应置评请求。

Mr. Huang, who employees say also has a hot temper, was aware of his daughter’s behavior. He occasionally threatened to sic an angry Ms. Huang on other employees and told them to be afraid of her, said two people familiar with the comments. And even senior executives thought they could not disagree with Ms. Huang because of her direct line to the boss.

员工说黄仁勋脾气也很火爆，他很清楚女儿的行为。据两名知情人士透露，他偶尔威胁要让愤怒的黄敏珊去对付其他员工，并告诉他们要怕她。甚至高级高管也认为，由于黄敏珊能直接向老板汇报，他们不敢对她提出异议。

“Nepotism is almost always a bad idea,” said David Yoffie, a Harvard Business School professor who has served on more than dozen corporate boards. “There are few examples of it even working modestly well.”

“任人唯亲几乎总是坏主意，”哈佛商学院教授戴维·约菲说。他曾在十多个公司董事会任职。“甚至连勉强算得上成功的例子都寥寥无几。”

Mr. Huang has said he wasn’t around much as a father. On a podcast recorded in April, he said he “missed a lot” of Madison and Spencer’s childhoods, including “all of their karate tournaments.” Mr. Huang’s wife, Lori, an accomplished electrical engineer, left her job to raise their children shortly before he co-founded Nvidia in 1993.

黄仁勋曾说，作为父亲，他陪伴孩子不多。在4月录制的一档播客中，他说自己错过了黄敏珊和黄胜斌童年的许多时光，包括“他们所有的空手道比赛”。黄仁勋的妻子洛丽是一位杰出的电气工程师，在1993年黄仁勋联合创立英伟达之前不久，她辞去了工作，专心抚养孩子。

黄仁勋的儿子黄胜斌，英伟达机器人产品管理总监。

His children learned from an early age to care about Nvidia.

他的孩子从小就学会关心英伟达的情况。

“Both kids have read every shareholder letter, gone to every shareholder meeting, been to every single conference that I’ve ever done,” Mr. Huang said on the podcast. “Despite the fact that I was gone a lot, they found a way to always love the company.”

“两个孩子都读过每一封致股东信，参加过每一次股东大会，出席过我办过的每一场会议，”黄仁勋在播客中说。“尽管我经常不在家，但他们始终热爱着这家公司。”

Mr. Huang’s children took winding paths to Nvidia. Madison received her bachelor’s degree from the Culinary Institute of America in 2012, and studied baking and wine at Le Cordon Bleu in Paris and London from 2013 to 2015, according to her profile on LinkedIn. She then managed luxury hotels and an Italian pastry shop owned by Louis Vuitton Moët Hennessey for four years. In 2019, she started at London Business School and then joined the family business in 2020.

黄仁勋的孩子们通过曲折的道路才加入英伟达。根据黄敏珊在领英上的资料，她2012年获得美国烹饪学院学士学位，2013年至2015年在巴黎和伦敦的蓝带学院学习烘焙和葡萄酒。随后四年，她管理路易威登酩悦轩尼诗旗下的豪华酒店和一家意大利甜品店。2019年，她进入伦敦商学院，然后于2020年加入家族企业。

Spencer, 36, received his bachelor’s degree from Columbia College Chicago, an arts school, in 2013, according to his profile on LinkedIn. He then owned a bar in Taipei called R&D Cocktail Lab for eight years. In 2022, he joined Nvidia, where he is now a director of product management for its robotics efforts. He is considered to be quiet and focused on his responsibilities, said seven people familiar with his work.

黄胜斌现年36岁，根据他在领英上的资料，他于2013年获得芝加哥哥伦比亚学院文理学院学士学位。随后八年在台北经营名为R&D Cocktail Lab的酒吧。2022年，他加入英伟达，现在是机器人业务的产品管理总监。七名熟悉其工作的人说，他被认为安静且专注于职责。

Mr. Caprez, who met Ms. Huang at London Business School, joined Nvidia in 2024 and became heavily involved in deal making. He has had a meteoric rise through the company, where he is now a vice president of A.I. infrastructure growth and had attended executive team meetings with Mr. Huang.

在伦敦商学院结识黄敏珊的卡普雷斯2024年加入英伟达，开始深度参与多项交易。他在公司迅速晋升，现在是人工智能基础设施增长副总裁，出席过黄仁勋的高管团队会议。

黄敏珊与丈夫尼科·卡普雷兹（英伟达全球人工智能基础设施发展副总裁）。

黄敏珊积极推广和保护父亲。和父亲一样，她也以脾气火爆闻名。据三名了解内情的人说，由于太多员工投诉黄敏珊，英伟达人力资源部门连续几个月安排她每周接受关于其管理风格的辅导。
2007年，黄敏珊、洛丽·黄、黄仁勋和黄胜斌在加利福尼亚州的一场晚宴上。

Over the years, Ms. Huang has also clashed with Ms. Kress, the company’s chief financial officer who is now also the interim chief executive, particularly over investments she was pursuing in robotics companies and deals Mr. Caprez wanted to strike with data center businesses, said four people familiar with the relationships.
据四名知情人士，多年来，黄敏珊还与时任首席财务官、现兼任临时首席执行官的克雷斯发生过冲突，尤其是在她寻求对机器人公司的投资以及卡普雷斯想与数据中心企业达成的交易上。
As her power inside Nvidia has grown over the past three years, Nvidia employees estimate that more than a dozen key executives have left the company because they disliked working with her.
过去三年，随着她在英伟达内部权力不断增长，英伟达员工估计，已有十多名关键高管因不喜欢与她共事而离开公司。

In meetings with other employees, Ms. Huang has yelled at her brother and executives who, on paper, managed her or were above her organizationally. Late last year, as Ms. Huang yelled at others on Nvidia’s marketing team, a vice president had a panic attack and had to leave the call with her, said two people familiar with the meeting.
据两名了解会议内情的人说，在与其他员工开会时，黄敏珊曾对她哥哥以及名义上管理她或组织层级高于她的高管大喊大叫。去年年底，当黄敏珊对英伟达营销团队其他人大喊时，一名副总裁惊恐发作，不得不退出与她的通话。

In March, ahead of Nvidia’s developer conference, Ms. Huang ripped into Ian Buck, a vice president at the company and the inventor of Cuda, a software that allows Nvidia’s chips to be used to train A.I.
3月，在英伟达开发者大会前，黄敏珊痛斥公司副总裁伊恩·巴克。巴克是CUDA软件的发明者，该软件使英伟达芯片可用于训练人工智能。

Mr. Buck hadn’t prepared a presentation for a briefing with reporters and had planned to improvise, a person familiar with the meeting said. Ms. Huang yelled at him in front of Nvidia’s communications team, and Mr. Buck later became upset with his own communications team. (Mr. Buck is now considered by some to be a front-runner to permanently succeed Mr. Huang.)
一名熟悉会议的人说，要向媒体介绍情况的巴克没有准备演示文稿，计划即兴发言。黄敏珊在英伟达公关团队面前对他大喊，巴克后来对自己的公关团队感到不满。（巴克现在被一些人视为正式接替黄仁勋的热门人选。）
Mr. Buck did not respond to requests for comment.
巴克没有回应置评请求。
To other employees, the exchange was confirmation of what they already knew: Ms. Huang was her father’s daughter.
对其他员工来说，这次交锋证实了他们已经知道的事：黄敏珊是她父亲的女儿。

比亚迪APP崩了

目前打开比亚迪 App 会显示“加载数据失败”“网络错误，请检查网络连接”，各个入口均无法正常显示，远程解锁、远程空调、桌面控车组件等依赖云端的操作均不可用。

眼下车主如需用车，可先用 NFC、蓝牙钥匙或实体钥匙解锁，这几类钥匙不依赖 App 云服务。

items.body:
格莱美奖新增亚洲奖 日本有2组艺人获得提名

被视为美国音乐界最高荣誉的格莱美奖提名名单16日公布。在为亚洲流行音乐新增的奖项中，日本共有2组艺人获得提名，分别是三人女子组合“BABYMETAL”和歌手LiSA（本名织部里沙）。韩国人气音乐组合“防弹少年团”（BTS）因反对“分地区及语言”设置奖项，决定不参加格莱美奖本身。

拥有日籍成员Rei的韩国女子组合“IVE”也入围该奖项。第69届格莱美奖颁奖典礼将于明年2月7日在洛杉矶举行。

新增奖项为“最佳亚洲流行音乐表演奖”。对象为源自亚洲音乐市场或在亚洲广受认可的艺人，使用亚洲语言也是条件之一。

该奖项于6月宣布设立。BTS在次月表示“希望音乐本身被聆听、被喜爱”，宣布放弃参评第69届格莱美奖。负责该奖项的录音学院最高负责人表示，评奖是为了让亚洲艺人受到关注，“割裂不是目的”。
